name: Skin & temperature

overlay.caption: cold takes heat → shiver to make heat → keep blood near the core

does: Shows shivering starting once the water is cold enough and growing as it gets colder
Shows blood flow to the skin dropping so warm blood stays near the organs
Shows shivering fading once wrapped up (halving every 2 minutes)
doesnt: Measure any real person — the numbers are illustrative teaching values
Show core temperature changing: it is displayed as steady because the body guards it
Model dangerous cold; the model stops well short of it
limits.text: This is a simplified learning model. Real people vary with age, fitness and health. The numbers are illustrative, not measurements of any real person.
limits.wellbeing: If someone can't stop shivering or seems confused in the cold, get an adult right away.

sources: CK-12 Life Science: integumentary system and homeostasis
